title: The Great Pyramid Used to Be Bright White

scenes.text: The Great Pyramid used to be bright white and shiny.
When it was finished about 4,500 years ago, it was covered in polished white limestone.
The casing stones were so smooth and bright that the pyramid reflected the sun like a giant mirror.
Over the centuries, earthquakes loosened the stones, and people carried them off to build mosques and houses in Cairo.
The rough, stepped pyramid you see today is just the inside layer.
Imagine a mountain of white glass glowing in the desert. That's what people saw.

description:
The pyramids of Giza were originally cased in polished white Tura limestone that gleamed in the sun.
Most of it was stripped away over the centuries to build Cairo. What's left is the rough core.
What other ancient wonder should we cover?
